decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 13 November 2022 Time 12:35 2022 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 November 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 46), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The following parts have been replaced and changes to the setup have been made: Floor (same specification) Front Wing/Nose assembly (different specification) Rear Wing (different specification)
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed items were replaced whilst the car was in parc ferme with the approval of the Technical Delegate. The front wing/nose assembly and the rear wing are of a different specification to that which was used previously. Changes have also been made to the setup of the suspension of car 22. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 22 Changes Under Parc Ferme
